text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P1, refine around adopted estimate artifacts rather than a second receipt hierarchy. Current FitEstimateProducer writes OLS estimator/noise/nuisance/run-combination provenance and scalar residual df. estimates.Products already has DfRole/DfValue/DegreesOfFreedom including approximate and unknown representations. EstimateGroup retains pinned inputs in GroupEstimateBlock, validates product/observation/target/pooling alignment and independent participant identities, and requires GroupEstimateAdmission.verify(units). This is substantial existing provenance support, not complete scientific admission. GroupData itself still contains effects/variances without first-level uncertainty semantics; the eager former FirstLevel.groupData is now FitGroupAdapter.groupData and still squares SEs without carrying df. Its meta-analysis-ready documentation must not be interpreted as calibrated inference admission. Remaining work: use the existing artifact/admission seam to bind and validate known/estimated/approximate/unknown uncertainty and sample-dependent df, qualify GLS and run-pooled producer receipts, define the eager bridge policy, and test subject/sample reorder, geometry evidence and refusals. Provenance is not calibration; retain independent numerical acceptance and do not invent effective df. Source-only assessment; no new inference admission or runtime qualification.
